identity: Song lyrics — the Arabic opening-title theme of a Batman cartoon. Structure: a chanted title line (بات مان x6), then a rhymed verse in two rhyme sets — an -irr set (الشر / مر / للسر) and an -iina set (امينة / اليقينا / المدينة / لمنادينا / حينا) — then the last two lines repeated verbatim as a chorus, then a chanted outro of three more بات مان lines. Register: sung, formulaic, heroic-descriptive; not prose, not a list, not a drill.
law: VERSE. The unit is the hemistich (شطر), not the printed <NL> line and not the grammatical sentence. Two signals fix the hemistich boundary and they agree everywhere in this document: (1) the rhyme. This song rhymes at mid-line as well as at line-end (تصريع), so any line that lands the rhyme twice is two units, and the cut goes at the first landing. (2) the corpus master law — one finite predication per information chunk. Every second hemistich here opens its own predication: فلا مكان للسر (clause-initial ف + new nominal predication), تكتشف اليقينا (asyndetic finite verb), رسم ندائا لمنادينا (asyndetic finite verb + own object), تلك اشارة بات مان (demonstrative-initial nominal clause). The short-tail brake is suspended in verse, so a two-word hemistich (تكتشف اليقينا) still stands alone. Countervailing limit: a repetition that carries no predication, no connective and no internal rhyme landing is one sung phrase, not a list — the بات مان chant lines take no internal cuts, however long the run.
reasoning: GENRE FIRST. I classified before reading for content, per my checklist. The tell is rhyme plus verbatim stanza repetition (L6=L8, L7=L9) plus a chanted name refrain — this is a sung lyric, so verse law governs and the short-tail rule is off. It is emphatically NOT a word-drill or an option list: there is no instruction line, no announcer, and the repeated element is a single name, not N parallel answer-candidates. So J1/I3 do not fire here. || THE RHYME IS THE RULER. Set 1: الشر (17), مر (24), للسر (32) — three -irr landings. But L4 runs عبر الطريق نحو الحقيقة فلا مكان للسر, seven tokens, with the rhyme only at its END. That means L4 is a long line holding a non-rhyming hemistich plus a rhyming one. Cut at 29 (الحقيقة). This is over-determined: فلا is clause-initial ف opening a new predication (لا مكان للسر = there is no place for secrecy), and my doctrine's B1 says clause-initial ف is essentially always a cut. Also عبر الطريق نحو الحقيقة is a bare PP frame completing انطلق from the previous line, not a predication of its own — so the boundary can only go after it, not inside it. No cut at 27 (الطريق): عبر الطريق / نحو الحقيقة are two bare adjuncts, no predication, conjunct-weight test fails. Confidence hi. || Set 2: امينة (36), اليقينا (38), المدينة (43), لمنادينا (46), حينا (51). Note that 36 and 43 are MID-line. That is the whole case for cutting inside L5 and L6, and it is confirmed by a clean structural parallel: لبطلنا روح امينة (4 words, nominal predication) | تكتشف اليقينا (verb-initial) and ضوء لمع وسط المدينة (4 words, verbal predication) | رسم ندائا لمنادينا (verb-initial). Same shape, same rhyme geometry, same verb-initial second half. Cut at 36 and at 43 (and 60 for the repeat). || THE ONE PLACE I ARGUED MYSELF OUT OF THE PROSE READING. In prose I would refuse the cut at 36: تكتشف اليقينا is an asyndetic relative clause on the indefinite antecedent روح امينة, and my connective table says relatives never open a unit. But K1 states that in verse metre and not syntax sets the boundary, and the mid-line rhyme landing on امينة is exactly the metrical marker. Weight beats syntax, as in §0. Taking it, confidence med. The parallel with L6 is what tips it: at 43 there is no relative-clause escape at all — رسم is a plain new finite verb with its own object, which is doctrine A6 asyndetic descriptive continuation, a cut on prose grounds alone. Two sites with the same rhyme geometry should not get opposite verdicts, so both cut. || L7/L9: حينا يبدو ويختفي حينا | تلك اشارة بات مان. Cut at 51 (and 68). تلك اشارة بات مان is a self-standing demonstrative-initial nominal clause — this is the same shape as E1 (هذا كلام العجائز / هذا حديث خرافة each a unit) — and it is the tag that breaks the -iina rhyme, which is why the rhyme lands on حينا at 51, i.e. the hemistich ends there. Confidence med, held back only because the whole line could conceivably be one sung breath. || THE SITE I DECLINED: و at 50/67 (ويختفي). My prior is 7:1 wrong in the merge direction and A1 says و plus a new finite predication is a cut, so I made myself argue this one out. Reasons to refuse: (a) the rhyme does not land on يبدو (49) — it lands on حينا (51), so 49 is not a hemistich end, and in verse the metre decides; (b) حينا يبدو ويختفي حينا is a chiasmus (adverb-verb / verb-adverb) around a single subject, one rhetorical figure, not an enumeration — B2 parallel-enumeration does not fire, F5 repetition-as-one-figure does; (c) metrically حينا يبدو ويختفي حينا is the same length as ضوء لمع وسط المدينة, i.e. exactly one hemistich, whereas حينا يبدو alone is half of one. No cut at 49 or 66. || THE CHANT LINES (L1 at 0-11, L10 at 74-83, L11 at 85-94, L12 at 96-99). No internal cuts. Argument: my under-cutting bias pushes toward splitting each بات مان, and I3/J1 do show that single words can be units — but only inside an option list or a drill, both of which require a list frame this document does not have. Here there is no predication anywhere in these lines, no connective for the conjunct-weight test, and no rhyme landing to mark a hemistich; F5 (repetition-with-intensification is one unit) is the closest precedent. The decisive evidence is the line lengths themselves: 6, then 5, 5, 2. If each بات مان were a unit the source would have no reason to break lines at 6/5/5/2 — that irregular grouping is exactly what wrapped chant lines look like, and the given line-end boundaries already segment them. One unit per chant line. Confidence med-hi. || CONSISTENCY CHECK. L6 and L8 are token-identical, as are L7 and L9; I gave them identical treatment (43/60 and 51/68). All 12 boundaries mandated by the format (tokens immediately before each <NL>, plus the final token 99) are present and none removed; no <NL> token carries a boundary. Total 18 boundaries, 6 of them my own judgement.
